_note: Clinical TNM and the anatomic stage group for breast cancer, transcribed from the AJCC Cancer Staging Manual, 8th edition (2017), chapter 48, pages 619 to 620 (licensed copy; internal instance only). 'text' is the criterion as printed (symbols restored where the scan's text layer lost them); 'find' is a phrase of the scan's own text layer that locates the line on the page for the highlight. Not switched on until a clinician has checked this file (docs/staging/DECISION.md, guard 5).

T.ask: the size of the primary breast tumour (greatest dimension) and any direct extension to the chest wall or skin (ulceration, satellite skin nodules, oedema or peau d'orange, inflammatory carcinoma)

N.ask: the regional lymph nodes on imaging or clinical examination: which level (axillary level I or II, infraclavicular level III, internal mammary, supraclavicular), whether movable or fixed or matted

M.ask: distant metastases on clinical or radiographic work-up

Extension to the chest wall; invasion or adherence to pectoralis muscle in the absence of invasion of chest wall structures does not qualify as T4
Ulceration and/or ipsilateral macroscopic satellite nodules and/or edema (including peau d'orange) of the skin that does not meet the criteria for inflammatory carcinoma
